evidence_method: Direct page fetches were blocked by this environment's network policy; terms were read only as search-index excerpts of the official pages. No page was opened in full; every cell needs legal confirmation against the live page.

use_values.CANDIDATE_PERMITTED: terms excerpt appears to permit, with the listed conditions
use_values.RESTRICTED_LICENCE_OR_CONSENT: needs a licence or written consent
use_values.PROHIBITED_WITHOUT_WRITTEN_CONSENT: terms excerpt forbids without written consent
use_values.UNKNOWN_LEGAL_REVIEW: terms unclear or not found; legal review required

b01_mapping: research-evidence/v1/contract.ts GrantSchema: status permitted|restricted|unknown, uses internal_research|public_display|derive, reviewerId with role rights_reviewer. Every source here maps to status=unknown until a rights reviewer records a grant.
